cli.finalMessage:
Looks correct and complete.

Built the approvals screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with mock data for 10 expense requests (styles in `Screen.module.css`, no `@strata/react` component imports were used since the package isn't installed in this environment — I couldn't verify its API, so I styled with plain elements using Strata CSS tokens (with safe fallbacks) and logical properties for RTL support instead).

Key behavior:
- Table shows employee, category, amount, date submitted, and a receipt link per row, plus a status badge.
- Checkboxes (with select-all/indeterminate state) let the manager multi-select pending rows; already-approved/rejected rows can't be reselected.
- Toolbar has Approve/Reject buttons, disabled until something's selected.
- Reject opens a modal requiring a non-empty reason before confirming.
- After either action, a dismissible banner reports how many requests were approved/rejected, and those rows update to the new status.

I can't run the app to visually verify, so please check the render in a browser.
